incident-bot: INCIDENT 1769123456 | Sev: P2 | region=us-east-1 | symptom=p95 latency > 650ms for 6m; smart-routing autoswap triggered -> model-quant-8bit (fallback). Page: @alice (oncall-sre). Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/latency/p95?orgId=1

alice (oncall-sre): acked. I'm on it. Can someone paste the runbook and confirm which routing policy executed the fallback?

bob (runtime-eng): digging in. quick summary: the autoswap flipped to model-quant-8bit at ~t0+3m due to p95 threshold breach. that variant has different kernel perf on A100 + AMP which caused KV-cache cold misses and longer kernel setup. reproducing logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:03:12Z] route-eval: baseline.p95=720ms -> threshold(650) breached
[2026-03-15T14:03:14Z] policy: smart-fallback v2 matched (region=us-east-1, severity=high)
[2026-03-15T14:03:15Z] action: swap route -> model-quant-8bit (variant id: q8_vid_42)
[2026-03-15T14:03:17Z] kvcache: miss_rate=83% (evictions spike)
[2026-03-15T14:03:40Z] p95 still high -> policy re-eval -> another swap attempted
```

bob (runtime-eng): policy config that fired looks like this (simplified):
```
policies.smart-fallback-v2 {
  p95_threshold_ms = 650
  evaluation_window = 180s
  cooldown = 60s
  max_retries = 3
  prefer_region_local = true
}
```

bob (runtime-eng): immediate hypothesis: cooldown too short + low hysteresis -> swaps while caches are warming, each swap causes extra latency (cold KV/cache, different kernels), causing p95 to spike again -> feedback loop. also one of the candidate variants (q8_vid_42) seems slower on our runtime patch set.

carla (eng-platform): agreed. recommend disabling smart-fallback for region us-east-1 until we stabilize. can do a targeted policy toggle: `redwoodctl policy update smart-fallback-v2 --region us-east-1 --enabled=false`

alice (oncall-sre): do that now pls. also pin the active route to the last-known-good model (baseline_vid_17) so we stop cycling.

carla (eng-platform): running commands now:
```
# disable fallback for us-east-1
redwoodctl policy update smart-fallback-v2 --region us-east-1 --enabled=false --as-of now
# pin route to baseline
redwoodctl routes update --region us-east-1 --route-id r-eu123 --pin-model baseline_vid_17 --reason "incident 1769123456 pin to stop oscillation"
```

carla (eng-platform): confirmed: policy disabled at ~t0+18m. route pinned to baseline_vid_17 at ~t0+19m.

denise (prod-eng): impact summary from product side: ~2.4% of requests in us-east-1 saw errors or >1.5s latency during the oscillation window. Support is seeing elevated tickets for two enterprise customers (orgAlpha, orgDelta) complaining about timeouts.

emma (support): samples from error logs (scrubbed):
```
{"org":"orgAlpha","err":"UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT","req_id":"r_9f3a"}
{"org":"orgDelta","err":"model_exec_timeout","req_id":"r_3b8c"}
```
We triaged, reached out proactively to orgAlpha and orgDelta. We have a few open tickets.

frank (customer-success): noted. I'll coordinate outreach: plan to send an incident summary + remediation note, offer 1:1 sync. Copying support template: "We're investigating increased latency impacting X% of requests in us-east-1; mitigation applied; follow-up actions & ETA to prevent recurrence."

bob (runtime-eng): after disabling fallback & pinning, I'm seeing p95 drop back to ~260ms within 4 minutes. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/latency/p95?panel=us-east-1&from=t0-30m&to=now. :thumbsup:

alice (oncall-sre): nice. please keep monitoring for another 30m. next steps: we need a post-incident action plan. I'll open INC-1769123456 in the tracker. owners: runtime-eng (bob) to debug why q8_vid_42 regressed on current runtime, eng-platform (carla) to add safety to policy toggles, product (denise) to draft customer comms, support/cs (emma/frank) to handle outreach.

bob (runtime-eng): immediate findings to capture: candidate variant q8_vid_42 had a kernel change that regresses cold-start path on our A100 config; KV cache eviction policy combined with small cache quota per replica caused high miss rate. reproducer attached to ticket.

carla (eng-platform): action items I propose:
- raise smart-fallback cooldown from 60s -> 180s
- add hysteresis percent check (only trigger fallback if p95 > threshold *and* increase by >20%)
- implement a "warm-acceptance" window: require variant to sustain better p95 for 2 eval windows before removing previous route
- add a feature-flag gate so autoswap can be disabled per-region in a single click from console

alice (oncall-sre): please put those as PRs and attach to INC-1769123456. Also run a canary (us-east-1a small traffic) with q8_vid_42 on staging to validate.

denise (prod-eng): customer comm draft ready, sending to cs for review.

emma (support): we've patched two tickets with update and ETA; awaiting response from orgAlpha for a call.

alice (oncall-sre): handoff: I'm leaving a summary in the incident channel and handing to next on-call (bob) for postmortem follow-ups. Items locked: policy disabled, route pinned, initial mitigations validated. Please escalate to eng leads if the regression repros on staging.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1769123456 status: mitigated -> monitoring. closed by automation at 1769127200. References: INC-1769123456, PRs: platform#489 (policy cooldown/hysteresis), runtime#512 (kernel fallback path fix).
